# Tommy Raffaello Hodoroaba

> 3D Artist e Developer con base a Torino. Dal 2019 nel team creativo di Alan Walker. Pipeline 3D completa in Blender e Unreal Engine 5, add-on Python per Blender, sviluppo su Roblox Studio (Luau).

## Pagine
- [Portfolio](https://portfoliotommy.netlify.app/#home): progetti 3D (characters, environments, hard surface, props, motion)
- [Codice](https://portfoliotommy.netlify.app/#code): tool, add-on e giochi in sviluppo
- [Profilo](https://portfoliotommy.netlify.app/#profile): esperienza, formazione, contatti
- [CV (PDF)](https://portfoliotommy.netlify.app/CV_3D_Tommy_Hodoroaba_2026.pdf)

## Progetti di codice
- [Ferrovie Tricolore](https://github.com/73K-Y/Ferrovie-Tricolore): simulatore ferroviario italiano in Roblox Studio (Luau)
- [tail_wrap_generator](https://github.com/73K-Y/tail_wrap_generator): add-on Blender in Python
- [3D-Workflow-Pipeline](https://github.com/73K-Y/3D-Workflow-Pipeline): pipeline Meshy AI, Blender, RetopoFlow 4, Auto-Rig Pro
